name: Dévaványa (Hungary)
description: Pale yellow field charged at the centre with the town arms of Dévaványa (a blue shield with a white horseman, with a helm and red and blue mantling) above the name DÉVAVÁNYA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dévaványa arms with helm and mantling
